recognize_zh: 雖標題寫切片，影像其實是骨髓抹片拼圖：可見多顆大型、染色質較開放的漿細胞，核偏位、細胞質藍而豐富帶核周淡染區，另有雙核形態，支持漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells, many large with abundant blue cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Perinuclear hof and open to moderately coarse chromatin; occasional nucleoli
Binucleated plasma cells and cells with irregular cytoplasmic outlines
Admixed erythroid precursors, neutrophils and lymphocytes
One panel shows an elongated cell with a long cytoplasmic tail (smearing artifact)
describe_en: Composite images show Romanowsky-stained bone marrow aspirate smears rather than histologic biopsy sections. Numerous plasma cells are present, many enlarged with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof and relatively open chromatin, including binucleated forms. Residual erythroid precursors, granulocytes and lymphocytes are admixed. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; the specimen type differs from the 'biopsy' description, and CD138 with kappa/lambda studies on the core are recommended for quantification and clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, polytypic and lack enlarged or binucleated forms.
Cells are uniformly blastic with prominent central nucleoli, high Ki-67 and frequent EBV positivity rather than a spectrum of recognizable plasma cells.
Osteoblasts are larger, occur in clusters in young patients, and their pale Golgi zone is separated from the nucleus.
